item_name: Rothco Backpack and Stool Combo Pack
item_short_desc: Rothco's Backpack and Stool Combo Pack offers convenience for outdoor enthusiasts. The backside of the camping backpack opens up to reveal a stool, ideal for breaks during long hikes or as a side table at your campsite. The outdoor stool features a large zip-up pocket for extra storage, while dual side zippered pockets with mesh outer pockets hold water bottles. A front zippered pocket secures smaller items. Constructed with a sturdy steel frame, this combo bag ensures long-term durability.
